The professor gave a lecture on the military strategies of Maccabaeus. 教授舉辦了一場關於這位古代領袖軍事策略的講座。

meaning: 屬於或關於猶大·馬加伯
sentences: The museum displayed several Maccabean coins from the ancient period. 博物館展示了幾枚來自古代的馬加伯時期硬幣。
They studied the Maccabean revolt to understand the region's history better. 他們研究了那場反抗運動，以更深入地了解該地區的歷史。

meaning: 一個祭司家族領導了一場始於公元前 168 年的猶太起義反對希臘文化和敘利亞統治，並從公元前 142 年開始統治巴勒斯坦。至西元前 63 年
sentences: The history class covered the rise and fall of the Maccabees. 歷史課講述了這個祭司家族的興衰。
She read a book detailing the daily life during the time of the Maccabees. 她讀了一本詳細描述那個家族統治時期日常生活的書。

meaning: 來自馬提尼克島的鼻煙
sentences: The old gentleman kept a small silver box filled with maccaboy in his pocket. 老紳士的口袋裡裝著一個裝滿這種玫瑰味鼻煙的銀色小盒。
She found a jar of maccaboy while cleaning out her grandfather's attic. 她在清理祖父的閣樓時，發現了一罐來自馬提尼克島的鼻煙。

meaning: 澳門的古變體
sentences: The merchants shipped their tea directly to Macco during the early trade period. 商人們在早期貿易期間將茶葉直接運往澳門。
He carefully studied the ancient shipping routes connecting Europe and Macco. 他仔細研究了連接歐洲與澳門的古代航線。

meaning: 一個罕見的或專門的英語術語，記錄為 maccoboy。
sentences: The old man enjoyed the scent of maccoboy when he used his snuff box. 這位老人使用他的鼻煙盒時，非常享受玫瑰香味鼻煙的味道。
He bought a fresh tin of maccoboy from the specialty tobacco shop. 他從專門的煙草店買了一罐新鮮的玫瑰鼻煙。

meaning: 一個罕見的或專門的英語術語，記錄為Macduff。
sentences: The brave nobleman Macduff fought to protect his country from the tyrant. 勇敢的貴族麥克德夫為了保護國家免受暴君統治而奮戰。
Historians study the influence of the Macduff family in ancient Scotland. 歷史學家研究麥克德夫家族在古代蘇格蘭的影響力。

meaning: 這種武器的儀式形式。
sentences: The chancellor carried a heavy silver mace during the graduation procession. 校長在畢業典禮遊行時手持一把沉重的銀色權杖。
We saw a beautifully decorated ceremonial mace safely kept in the royal treasury. 我們在皇家金庫裡看到了一把裝飾精美的儀仗權杖。

meaning: 罕見或專門的英語術語，記錄為 macedoine。
sentences: We enjoyed a cold macedoine of summer fruits for dessert. 我們享用了冰涼的夏日水果丁盤作為甜點。
The chef prepared a colorful macedoine of vegetables to serve with the fish. 廚師準備了色彩繽紛的雜菜丁來搭配魚肉食用。

meaning: 希臘東北部巴爾幹半島的南歐地區、北馬其頓的前南斯拉夫部分和保加利亞西南部，包括古馬其頓王國（或馬其頓首都佩拉）的領土
sentences: He accepted the Macedon with more caution than pride. 他接受馬其頓的時候更加謹慎，而不是驕傲。
The old records show how the Macedon shaped local history. 古老的記錄顯示了馬其頓人如何塑造了當地的歷史。

meaning: 古馬其頓的語言，親和力不確定，但通常被認為是印歐語系
sentences: We found Macedonian growing near the stream bank after the rain. 雨後我們發現馬其頓在河岸附近生長。
The field guide helped us identify Macedonian among the other plants. 現場指南幫助我們在其他植物中識別出馬其頓植物。

meaning: 馬其頓語
sentences: She spent three years studying Macedonic before traveling to the region for business. 她在前往該地區出差前花了三年時間學習馬其頓語。
The language professor can translate several ancient Macedonic documents fluently. 這位語言學教授能流利地翻譯幾份古老的馬其頓語文件。

meaning: 馬圖瓦
sentences: The artist used a macehead to create a textured, grainy effect on the copper plate. 藝術家使用磨點刀在銅板上創造出有紋理的顆粒效果。
Keep the macehead sharp to ensure the stippling remains consistent across the image. 保持磨點工具鋒利，以確保圖像上的點刻效果保持一致。

meaning: 一個罕見的或專門的英語術語，記錄為 maceman。
sentences: The maceman carried a heavy staff during the parade. 執事官在遊行中持著一根沉重的權杖。
In old courts, the maceman stood next to the judge. 在舊時的法庭上，執杖官站在法官旁邊。

meaning: 狼牙棒持有者；具體來說：蘇格蘭的一名法院官員，負責維持秩序、執行搜索令和類似職責
sentences: He accepted the macer with more caution than pride. 他接過錘子時更加謹慎，而不是驕傲。
The old records show how the macer shaped local history. 古老的記錄顯示了切碎機如何塑造了當地的歷史。

meaning: 一個罕見的或專門的英語術語，記錄為浸漬。
sentences: You should macerate the berries in sugar to make a sweet sauce. 你應該將漿果浸泡在糖中以製作甜醬汁。
The sample became macerate after sitting in the chemical solution for two days. 樣本在化學溶液中浸泡兩天後變得浸軟了。

meaning: 一個罕見的或專門的英語術語，記錄為浸漬器。
sentences: The laboratory uses a specialized macerater to break down tissue samples. 實驗室使用專門的浸漬器來分解組織樣本。
The plumber fixed the kitchen macerater that was clogged with food waste. 水管工修理了被廚餘堵塞的廚房粉碎機。

meaning: 一個罕見的或專門的英語術語，記錄為浸漬。
sentences: The maceration of the herbs in oil helps extract their natural scent. 將草藥浸泡在油中後的浸漬過程有助於提取其天然香氣。
Long exposure to the rain caused the maceration of the cardboard boxes. 長時間淋雨導致紙箱產生了浸軟腐爛的現象。

meaning: 一個罕見的或專門的英語術語，記錄為 Macflecknoe。
sentences: Macflecknoe is a famous satirical poem by John Dryden. 《麥克弗萊克諾》是約翰·德萊頓著名的諷刺詩。
We discussed the humor used in Macflecknoe during the lecture. 我們在講座中討論了《麥克弗萊克諾》中所使用的幽默手法。

meaning: 屬於或與之相關的Machairodus屬或相關劍齒貓（Machairodontinae亞科）
sentences: The researchers discovered a well-preserved machairodont skull deep inside the limestone cave. 研究人員在石灰岩洞穴深處發現了一個保存完好的劍齒虎類頭骨。
This massive jawbone clearly belongs to a large machairodont predator from the Pleistocene epoch. 這塊巨大的顎骨顯然屬於更新世時期的一種大型劍齒虎類掠食者。

meaning: 罕見或專業的英語術語，記錄為 Machairodontidae。
sentences: The museum displayed a skull from a member of the Machairodontidae family. 博物館展示了一個屬於劍齒虎科成員的頭骨。
Machairodontidae were ancient predators known for their large canine teeth. 劍齒虎科是古代的掠食者，以其巨大的犬齒而聞名。

meaning: 一個罕見或專門的英語術語，記錄為 Machairodontinae。
sentences: Scientists study the hunting habits of the extinct Machairodontinae subfamily. 科學家研究已滅絕的劍齒虎亞科的狩獵習慣。
The Machairodontinae lived in many parts of the world millions of years ago. 劍齒虎亞科在數百萬年前生活在世界許多地方。

meaning: 中新世、上新世和更新世的劍齒虎屬（Machairodontinae亞科），與劍齒虎屬的食肉動物相似，但通常有較小的犬齒
sentences: A complete fossil of Machairodus was carefully excavated by the university paleontology team. 大學的古生物學團隊仔細挖掘出了一具完整的劍齒虎屬化石。
Machairodus hunted large herbivores across the vast grasslands of ancient Eurasia. 這種劍齒虎在古代歐亞大陸的廣闊草原上捕獵大型草食動物。

meaning: 狩獵老虎時用於觀察的平台（如樹上的平台）
sentences: The wildlife photographer sat quietly in the machan all night to capture a perfect photo of the tiger. 野生動物攝影師在樹上的觀察台靜靜地坐了一整夜，只為了拍下完美的老虎照片。
They built a sturdy machan high in the branches to safely monitor the animal paths below. 他們在樹枝高處建造了一個堅固的平台，以便安全地監控下方的動物路徑。

meaning: 平坦或低窪的平原或田野
sentences: The farmers grazed their cattle on the green machar near the coastline during the summer months. 夏天時，農夫們在海岸邊翠綠的低窪平原上放牧牛群。
Wildflowers bloom beautifully across the wide machar every spring, attracting many bees. 每年春天，廣闊的平坦田野上都會開滿美麗的野花，吸引了許多蜜蜂。

meaning: 用砍刀切割或砍伐。
sentences: After some hours of intense work, we had macheted a path through the jungle to the bank of the river. 經過幾個小時的緊張工作，我們開闢了一條穿過叢林到達河岸的小路。
To machete means to cut or chop with a machete. 砍刀意味著用砍刀切割或砍伐。

meaning: 一把大而重的刀，用於切割甘蔗和灌木叢以及作為武器
sentences: The agricultural workers used sharp Machetes to quickly clear the thick jungle path. 農業工人們用鋒利的開山刀迅速清理茂密的叢林小徑。
We packed two sturdy Machetes for chopping firewood during our weekend camping trip. 我們在週末的露營之旅中帶了兩把堅固的大砍刀用來劈柴。

meaning: 日本城鎮或商業中心；特別是：與純農村村協調的最低行政區劃
sentences: We explored a traditional machi in Kyoto and found many fascinating local artisan shops. 我們探索了京都的一個傳統城鎮，並發現了許多迷人的當地工匠店鋪。
The local government of the machi organized a grand festival to celebrate the spring harvest. 該町的地方政府組織了一場盛大的祭典來慶祝春收。

meaning: 馬基雅維利式的
sentences: The young politician was known as a ruthless Machiavel who would betray anyone to gain power. 這位年輕的政治家被稱為一個冷酷無情的權謀者，為了奪取權力不惜背叛任何人。
He played the role of a clever Machiavel perfectly during the corporate board meetings. 他在公司董事會會議上完美地扮演了一個狡猾謀略家的角色。

meaning: 一個罕見的或專門的英語術語，記錄為馬基雅維利（Machiavellian）。
sentences: The manager used Machiavellian tactics to get his rival fired. 經理使用權謀手段讓他的對手被解僱。
His Machiavellian nature made it hard for anyone to trust him completely. 他那不擇手段的性格讓人很難完全信任他。

meaning: 馬基雅維利的政治理論；特別是：認為政治是不道德的，任何手段，無論多麼不道德，都可以合理地用於獲取政治權力
sentences: The general manager's strict leadership style was often criticized as a form of corporate Machiavellianism. 總經理嚴厲的領導風格經常被批評為一種企業界的馬基維利主義。
The political science professor gave a fascinating lecture on the rise of Machiavellianism in European history. 政治學教授舉辦了一場關於歐洲歷史上馬基維利主義興起的精彩講座。

meaning: 以馬基雅維利式的方式
sentences: The manager acted Machiavellianly to secure the promotion, manipulating his colleagues against each other. 那位經理為了確保獲得晉升而耍弄權術，挑撥同事之間的關係。
They negotiated Machiavellianly behind closed doors to outsmart their business rivals. 他們在閉門會議中不擇手段地談判，以求智取商業對手。

meaning: 馬基雅維利式的
sentences: His Machiavellic strategies eventually alienated all of his reliable business partners. 他的馬基維利式策略最終疏遠了他所有可靠的商業夥伴。
The historical drama tells the story of a Machiavellic king who rules his country with fear and deception. 這部歷史劇講述了一位以恐懼和欺騙統治國家的不擇手段國王的故事。

meaning: 馬基雅維利主義
sentences: Her approach to office politics relies entirely on pure Machiavellism to achieve immediate results. 她處理辦公室政治的方法完全依賴純粹的馬基維利主義來達到立竿見影的效果。
The new documentary explores the hidden dangers of Machiavellism in modern democratic societies. 這部新紀錄片探討了現代民主社會中馬基維利主義的潛在危險。

meaning: 一個罕見的或專門的英語術語，記錄為馬基雅維利主義者。
sentences: The politician was a known machiavellist who would do anything to win. 這位政治家是個出名的權謀家，為了獲勝不擇手段。
As a machiavellist, he always has a secret plan to gain more power. 作為一個權術家，他總是有一個贏得更多權力的秘密計劃。

meaning: 一個罕見的或專門的英語術語，記錄為馬基雅維利主義。
sentences: The company's Machiavellistic culture encouraged employees to compete unfairly. 公司的權謀文化鼓勵員工進行不公平的競爭。
She regretted her Machiavellistic behavior after losing all her friends. 在失去所有朋友後，她對自己那種不擇手段的行為感到後悔。

meaning: 裝備（作為砲塔）機械裝置
sentences: The architect decided to machicolate the castle towers to significantly improve their defensive capabilities. 建築師決定為城堡塔樓設置防禦用堞口，以大幅提升其防禦能力。
They had to quickly machicolate the outer walls before the enemy army arrived at the gates. 他們必須在敵軍抵達城門之前，迅速在城牆外側裝備防禦投射孔。

meaning: 突出護牆的牛腿之間或走廊地板或門戶屋頂上的開口，用於向下方的攻擊者發射導彈
sentences: The defenders poured boiling water through the narrow machicolation to drive away the attackers below. 守軍透過狹窄的防禦孔倒下沸水，藉此擊退下方的攻擊者。
We examined a well-preserved machicolation right above the main fortress entrance during our tour. 在參觀過程中，我們仔細觀察了要塞正門上方一個保存完好的防禦投射孔。

meaning: 機械化
sentences: Defenders dropped heavy stones through the machicoulis onto the invaders below. 防禦者通過城堞投射孔將巨石投向下方的入侵者。
The ancient castle features a well-preserved machicoulis along its outer walls. 這座古老城堡的外牆上有保存完好的挑出式投射口。

meaning: 一個罕見的或專門的英語術語，記錄為Machicui。
sentences: The Machicui community works hard to preserve their native language. 瑪奇庫伊社群努力保護其母語。
We learned about the traditional hunting methods used by the Machicui people. 我們了解了瑪奇庫伊人使用的傳統狩獵方法。

meaning: 掛在一根桿子上的吊床，在非洲許多地方用於載客
sentences: The medical team used a traditional machila to transport the injured patient safely down the mountain trail. 醫療團隊使用傳統的抬桿吊床，將受傷的病患安全地運送下山。
He rested comfortably in a machila as two strong porters carried him through the dense jungle. 他舒適地躺在轎床裡，由兩名強壯的搬運工抬著穿過茂密的叢林。

meaning: 原始昆蟲的世界性家族（纓尾目），身體背凸，有連續的複眼和三個單眼
sentences: Researchers observed a Machilidae near the edge of the field at dawn. 黎明時分，研究人員在田野邊緣附近觀察到了一隻原始昆蟲的世界性家族。
The illustration showed the Machilidae in its natural setting. 插圖展示了自然環境下的馬奇里科動物。

meaning: 舊大陸非常原始的昆蟲屬，屬於Machilidae科的類型
sentences: Researchers observed a Machilis near the edge of the field at dawn. 研究人員在黎明時分在田野邊緣附近觀察到了一隻馬奇利斯。
The illustration showed the Machilis in its natural setting. 插圖展示了 舊大陸非常原始的昆蟲屬，屬於Machilidae科的類型 的自然環境。

meaning: 菲律賓灰棕色長尾獼猴（Macaca philippinensis）
sentences: The field biologist observed a small group of machin grooming each other near the riverbank. 野外生物學家觀察到一小群菲律賓長尾獼猴在河岸邊互相理毛。
Tourists are strictly warned not to feed the wild machin that roam around the temple grounds. 遊客被嚴格警告不要餵食在寺廟周圍漫遊的野生長尾獼猴。

meaning: 可加工的品質或狀態
sentences: The new aluminum alloy possesses excellent machinability, making it perfect for manufacturing automotive parts. 這種新型鋁合金具有極佳的可加工性，非常適合用來製造汽車零件。
Engineers carefully tested the machinability of the metal block before starting the mass production process. 工程師在開始量產流程之前，仔細測試了該金屬塊的加工性能。

meaning: 能夠或適合被機械加工
sentences: The factory uses a highly machinable plastic to quickly produce precise medical instruments. 工廠使用高度易加工的塑膠來快速生產精密的醫療儀器。
We need to verify that this tough ceramic material is fully machinable with our current cutting tools. 我們必須確認這種堅硬的陶瓷材料完全可以使用我們現有的切割工具進行加工。

meaning: 屬於或與機器有關的：機械的
sentences: The supervisor analyzed the machinal efficiency of the newly installed assembly line in the factory. 主管分析了工廠內新安裝裝配線的機械效率。
His machinal movements suggested he was completely exhausted from hours of repetitive warehouse labor. 他機械化的動作表明，他已經因為數小時的重複性倉庫勞動而筋疲力盡。

meaning: 特別計劃或密謀造成傷害
sentences: The ambitious marketing director began to machinate against his colleagues to secure the promotion. 這位野心勃勃的行銷總監開始暗中策劃對付同事，以確保能獲得晉升。
It took the hackers several months to machinate the complex financial fraud that eventually ruined the company. 駭客們花了幾個月的時間密謀這場最終毀掉公司的複雜金融騙局。

meaning: 一種操縱行為。如何在句子中使用機器。機械加工的同義詞討論
sentences: The business deal failed because of the secret machination of a competitor. 由於競爭對手的秘密陰謀，這樁商業交易失敗了。
He was tired of the constant political machination in the office. 他對辦公室裡不斷發生的政治權謀感到厭倦。

meaning: 陰謀家：陰謀家或狡猾的陰謀家
sentences: The machinator worked behind the scenes to disrupt the election. 這位陰謀家在幕後操縱以破壞選舉。
He was known as a brilliant machinator who could manipulate any situation. 他被公認為一個能操縱任何局面的高明策劃者。

meaning: 機器
sentences: The washing machine is making a strange noise. 洗衣機正發出奇怪的噪音。
Modern factories use advanced machines to increase production. 現代工廠使用先進機器來增加產量。

meaning: 一個罕見的或專門的英語術語，記錄為機器。
sentences: The machineful laboratory was equipped with the latest technology. 這個裝滿機器的實驗室配備了最新的技術。
Modern life can sometimes feel too machineful and lacking in human touch. 現代生活有時會讓人感覺過於機械化，缺乏人情味。

meaning: 缺乏或無需機器即可完成；特別是燙髮：不使用連接到加熱裝置的捲髮器進行準備：冷燙

meaning: 亞洲藤棕櫚（尤其是菖蒲）的常有斑駁的細長木莖，特別用於製作手杖和雨傘手柄
sentences: He walked with a cane made from a sturdy piece of Malacca. 他拄著一根由堅固的馬六甲藤木製成的手杖。
The handle of the expensive umbrella was crafted from Malacca. 這把昂貴雨傘的手柄是由馬六甲藤莖製成的。

meaning: 馬來半島上的馬六甲（馬六甲）的或與之相關的
sentences: We enjoyed tasting various Malaccan dishes during our trip to Malaysia. 在馬來西亞旅行期間，我們很喜歡品嚐各種馬六甲當地的菜餚。
The Malaccan history is reflected in the old buildings of the city. 馬六甲的歷史反映在城市裡的建築風格中。

meaning: 一個罕見的或專門的英語術語，被記錄為“malaccident”。
sentences: A minor malaccident with the delivery truck caused a short delay in the schedule. 貨車發生的一個小意外導致行程略有延誤。
He considered the spilled coffee a small malaccident that did not ruin his day. 他認為弄翻咖啡只是一個小不幸，並未毀掉他的一天。

meaning: 由薔薇科（如蘋果、榅桲、梨）成員組成的灌木和喬木科，其心皮聯合並貼生於萼管
sentences: We found Malaceae growing near the damp meadow after the rain. 我們發現雨後潮濕的草地附近長出了馬拉科植物。
The field guide helped us identify Malaceae among the other plants. 現場指南幫助我們在其他植物中識別出馬拉科科植物。

meaning: 一個罕見的或專門的英語術語，記錄為惡意的。
sentences: The orchard is filled with malaceous trees that produce sweet apples and pears. 果園裡種滿了結出甜美蘋果和梨子的蘋果類樹木。
She loves the smell of blossoming malaceous flowers in the early spring. 她喜歡早春時節蘋果類花朵綻放的香味。

meaning: 一種綠色礦物，是銅的鹼式碳酸鹽，特別用於製造裝飾品
sentences: The artist carved a beautiful statue out of a block of malachite. 藝術家在一塊孔雀石上雕刻出一尊美麗的雕像。
She wore a necklace with a bright green malachite pendant. 她戴著一條鑲有亮綠色孔雀石墜子的項鍊。

meaning: 組織異常軟化－通常合併使用。如何用 malacia 造句
sentences: The vet explained that the dog's joint pain was caused by a form of malacia. 獸醫解釋說，這隻狗的關節疼痛是由於某種形式的軟化症引起的。
Adequate calcium is important to prevent bone malacia in growing children. 攝取足夠的鈣對於預防發育中兒童的骨軟化症非常重要。

meaning: 中等大小的北美食用水龜屬（陸龜科），包括小菜龜
sentences: Malaclemys turtles are found in the brackish waters along the coast. 鑽紋龜屬的烏龜生活在沿岸的鹹淡水中。
The biologist monitored the nesting sites of the Malaclemys population. 生物學家監測了鑽紋龜屬族群的築巢地點。

meaning: 一個罕見或專門的英語術語，記錄為 Malaclypse。
sentences: Writers use Malaclypse for rare or specialized English term recorded as Malaclypse. 作家使用 一個罕見或專門的英語術語，記錄為 Malaclypse。 來表示罕見或專門的英語術語，記錄為 一個罕見或專門的英語術語，記錄為 Malaclypse。。
The word Malaclypse still appears in older books and notes. 「一個罕見或專門的英語術語，記錄為 Malaclypse。」這個字仍然出現在較舊的書籍和筆記中。

meaning: 寬紐蟲屬（Bdellonemertea），類似水蛭，共生於蛤蜊和其他軟體動物的鰓腔中
sentences: Researchers observed a Malacobdella near the edge of the field at dawn. 黎明時分，研究人員在田野邊緣附近觀察到了一條馬拉科布德拉。
The illustration showed the Malacobdella in its natural setting. 插圖展示了 寬紐蟲屬 的自然環境。

meaning: 分類學同義詞 digenea
sentences: The student observed the Malacocotylea specimen to study its parasitic behavior. 學生觀察了這個複殖吸蟲標本，以研究其寄生行為。
Treatment was needed to clear the Malacocotylea infection from the fish pond. 為了清除魚塘中的複殖吸蟲感染，需要進行治療。

meaning: 一個罕見的或專門的英語術語，記錄為 malacoderm。
sentences: The biologist found a rare malacoderm with a soft, bright orange body. 生物學家發現了一種罕見的、具有柔軟亮橘色身體的軟體甲蟲。
Most malacoderm beetles are active during the night and hide under leaves. 大多數軟體甲蟲在夜間活動，並躲在葉子下面。

meaning: 一個罕見或專門的英語術語，記錄為 Malacodermatidae。
sentences: Research into the Malacodermatidae family helps us understand beetle evolution. 對軟體甲蟲科的研究有助於我們了解甲蟲的進化。
The new species was officially placed in the Malacodermatidae group last year. 去年，這個新物種被正式歸入軟體甲蟲科。

meaning: 一個罕見的或專門的英語術語，記錄為 malacodermatous。
sentences: The malacodermatous larvae are very sensitive to changes in soil moisture. 這些軟皮幼蟲對土壤水分的變化非常敏感。
He noted that the malacodermatous skin of the insect made it very flexible. 他注意到這種昆蟲柔軟的皮膚使其活動非常靈活。

meaning: 一個罕見或專門的英語術語，記錄為 Malacodermidae。
sentences: Scientists collected several different beetles from the Malacodermidae family. 科學家們收集了幾種不同的軟體甲蟲科甲蟲。
The Malacodermidae group includes many species that can produce light. 軟體甲蟲科包含許多能夠發光的物種。

meaning: 一個罕見的或專門的英語術語，記錄為 malacodermous。
sentences: Birds often avoid eating these malacodermous beetles because they taste bitter. 鳥類通常避免食用這些軟皮甲蟲，因為它們味道很苦。
The malacodermous nature of the specimen required it to be kept in a special fluid. 由於標本具有軟皮特性，需要將其保存在特殊的液體中。

meaning: 具有柔軟或粘液結構或質地。如何用 malacoid 造句
sentences: The wet sponge had a malacoid texture that made it easy to squeeze. 濕海綿具有柔軟的質地，使其很容易擠壓。
A malacoid layer of moss covered the damp rocks near the waterfall. 瀑布附近潮濕的岩石上覆蓋著一層軟綿綿的苔蘚。

meaning: 透輝石；特別是：淺色半透明透輝石
sentences: The geologist collected a sample of malacolite from the quarry. 地質學家從採石場採集了一塊透輝石樣本。
Rare jewelry pieces are sometimes set with translucent malacolite. 稀有的珠寶有時會鑲嵌半透明的透輝石。

meaning: 軟體動物學的或與之相關的
sentences: The museum has a large malacological collection of sea shells. 博物館擁有大量軟體動物學方面的海貝收藏。
They conducted a malacological survey to study the snails in the lake. 他們進行了一項軟體動物學調查，以研究湖中的蝸牛。

meaning: 軟體動物學專家
sentences: The malacologist spent years studying the life cycle of giant clams. 這位軟體動物學家花了多年時間研究巨蚌的生命週期。
We asked a malacologist to help identify the strange shell we found. 我們請教了一位軟體動物學家，幫忙鑑定我們發現的奇怪貝殼。

meaning: 動物學的一個分支，研究軟體動物
sentences: Students interested in squids and octopuses should study malacology. 對烏賊和章魚感興趣的學生應該學習軟體動物學。
New discoveries in malacology have changed our understanding of ocean life. 軟體動物學的新發現改變了我們對海洋生物的理解。

meaning: 鋯石的棕色蝕變形式
sentences: The brown color of the crystal suggests it might be malacon. 水晶的棕色顯示它可能是變質的鋯石。
Scientists analyzed the radioactive elements found within the malacon. 科學家分析了在這種變質鋯石中發現的放射性元素。

meaning: 適應蝸牛授粉－尤其用於某些海芋的花
sentences: Botanists describe a specimen as malacophilous when it is adapted to pollination by snails —used especially of the flowers of some arums. 當一種標本適應了蝸牛授粉時，植物學家將其描述為嗜軟性的——尤其是用於某些海芋花的授粉。
Under the lens, the plant looked malacophilous to the researchers. 在鏡頭下，研究人員認為這種植物看起來像軟食動物。

meaning: 一種罕見的或專門的英語術語，記錄為軟音。
sentences: The teacher spoke in a malacophonous tone to keep the students calm. 老師用柔和的語氣說話，以保持學生們的冷靜。
We listened to the malacophonous sound of the wind blowing through the grass. 我們聆聽著微風吹過草叢時那柔和的聲音。

meaning: 有柔軟或肉質的葉子。如何用 malacophyllous 造句
sentences: The gardener prefers malacophyllous plants because their thick leaves look lush. 園丁更喜歡肉質葉植物，因為它們肥厚的葉子看起來很茂盛。
The malacophyllous desert plants can survive for a long time without rain. 這些具有肉質葉的沙漠植物可以在沒有雨水的情況下存活很久。

meaning: 一個罕見的或專門的英語術語，記錄為 malacopod。
sentences: The biologist studied the malacopod moving slowly across the damp forest floor. 生物學家觀察這隻軟足類動物在潮濕的森林地面上緩慢移動。
These malacopods are often found in tropical environments under rotting logs. 這些有爪動物通常出現在熱帶環境的腐木下方。

meaning: 甲藻的分類同義詞
sentences: Malacopoda is a group of invertebrates that share characteristics with both worms and insects. 軟足類是一群兼具蠕蟲和昆蟲特徵的無脊椎動物。
Scientists use the term Malacopoda to classify these unique multi-legged creatures. 科學家使用這個分類術語來歸類這些獨特的多足生物。

meaning: 一個罕見的或專門的英語術語，記錄為 malacopodous。
sentences: The creature has a malacopodous body structure that allows it to squeeze through tight gaps. 這種生物具有軟足類的身體構造，讓它能擠過狹小的縫隙。
Many soil-dwelling organisms are malacopodous to better navigate through loose earth. 許多穴居土壤的生物都有柔軟的足部，以便在鬆散的土中穿行。

meaning: 屬於或關於軟翅目
sentences: Salmon and trout are common examples of a malacopterygian fish. 鮭魚和鱒魚是常見的軟鰭類魚類。
The professor explained the skeletal structure of a malacopterygian species. 教授解釋了軟鰭目物種的骨骼結構。

meaning: 具有軟鰭條的硬骨魚的廣泛分支
sentences: Researchers observed a Malacopterygii near the edge of the field at dawn. 黎明時分，研究人員在田野邊緣附近觀察到了一條軟鰭龍。
The illustration showed the Malacopterygii in its natural setting. 插圖展示了自然環境中的軟翅目。

meaning: 具有軟鰭條的硬骨魚的廣泛分支
sentences: Many malacopterygious fish live in the deep parts of the ocean. 許多軟鰭類的魚生活在海洋深處。
We can distinguish these species by their malacopterygious fin structure. 我們可以透過其軟鰭條的結構來區分這些物種。

meaning: 一個罕見或專門的英語術語，記錄為 Malacoscolices。
sentences: The researcher examined the Malacoscolices found in the deep sea sediment. 研究人員檢查了在深海沉積物中發現的軟體蠕蟲。
Deep ocean exploration has revealed several new species belonging to Malacoscolices. 深海探索發現了數種屬於這類軟體無脊椎動物的新物種。

meaning: 一個罕見或專門的英語術語，記錄為 Malacoscolicine。
sentences: The specimen showed Malacoscolicine features under the microscope. 樣本在顯微鏡下展現出軟體蠕蟲類的特徵。
Students learned about the Malacoscolicine life cycle in their marine biology class. 學生們在海洋生物課上學習了這種軟體無脊椎動物的生命週期。

meaning: 蛾屬（Lasiocampidae科），包括常見的帳篷毛毛蟲
sentences: Malacosoma caterpillars build silk tents in the branches of trees. 幕蛾屬的毛毛蟲在樹枝間搭建絲狀的帳篷。
Farmers were concerned about Malacosoma damaging the fruit trees. 農民擔心幕蛾屬會對果樹造成損害。

meaning: 甲殼綱的一個主要亞綱，包括該組中大多數著名的海洋、淡水和陸地成員（如龍蝦、螃蟹、蝦、母蝽、海灘跳蚤）
sentences: Many species in the Malacostraca subclass are popular seafood choices. 軟甲綱中的許多物種都是受歡迎的海鮮選擇。
The Malacostraca group includes creatures with hard shells like crabs and lobsters. 軟甲綱這一類群包括螃蟹和龍蝦等具有硬殼的生物。

meaning: 甲殼動物的一個大亞綱（軟甲綱），其胸部由八個節段組成，通常被甲殼覆蓋，包括十足目動物和等足動物
sentences: The scientist studied a specific malacostracan found in the deep ocean. 科學家研究了一種在深海發現的特定軟甲綱動物。
A shrimp is a common example of a malacostracan. 蝦子是軟甲綱動物的一個常見例子。

meaning: 一個罕見的或專門的英語術語，記錄為 malacostracology。
sentences: He decided to specialize in malacostracology to study the behavior of deep-sea crabs. 他決定專攻軟甲動物學，以研究深海螃蟹的行為。
Advances in malacostracology have helped us understand the diversity of shrimp species. 軟甲類研究的進展幫助我們了解蝦類物種的多樣性。

meaning: 甲殼綱的一個主要亞綱，包括該組中大多數著名的海洋、淡水和陸地成員（如龍蝦、螃蟹、蝦、母蝽、海灘跳蚤）
sentences: The researcher examined the malacostracous features of the fossil. 研究人員檢查了化石的軟甲綱特徵。
We classified the specimen based on its malacostracous characteristics. 我們根據其軟甲綱特徵對標本進行了分類。

meaning: 一個罕見的或專門的英語術語，記錄為 malacic。
sentences: The doctor prescribed a malactic ointment to soothe the patient's dry skin. 醫生開了一種具軟化作用的軟膏來緩解病患乾燥的皮膚。
This herbal tea is known for its malactic properties that help relax the muscles. 這種草本茶以其舒緩功效聞名，能幫助放鬆肌肉。

meaning: 適應性差或不充分。如何用適應不良造句
sentences: The plant's small leaves were a maladaptation to the extremely wet climate. 這種植物的小葉片是對極度潮濕氣候的一種適應不良。
Scientists worry that rapid temperature changes will lead to species maladaptation. 科學家擔心氣溫快速變化會導致物種適應不當。

meaning: 一個罕見的或專門的英語術語，記錄為不當地址。
sentences: His maladdress in handling the delicate glass vase caused it to shatter. 他處理精緻玻璃花瓶時的笨拙導致花瓶破碎了。
Despite her maladdress in social situations, she was a brilliant engineer. 儘管她在社交場合顯得笨手笨腳，但她是一位才華橫溢的工程師。

meaning: 疾病或疾病的、與疾病或疾病相關的、或受其影響的：病弱的、虛弱的。如何用 maladive 造句
sentences: The child had a maladive appearance after staying indoors for so long. 孩子在室內待了這麼久後，看起來面色蒼白且病弱。
Her maladive constitution made it difficult for her to participate in sports. 她虛弱的體質讓她很難參加體育活動。

meaning: 一個罕見的或專門的英語術語，記錄為“maladjust”。
sentences: Children might maladjust to a new school if they don't make friends quickly. 如果孩子沒有很快交到朋友，他們可能會對新學校適應不良。
It is common for people to maladjust when they first move to a foreign country. 當人們剛搬到國外時，初期產生適應問題是很常見的。

meaning: 調整不當或不充分；具體來說：由於未能根據生活條件調整自己的願望而與環境缺乏和諧。如何用失調造句
sentences: The specimen looked maladjusted under the bright lab light. 在明亮的實驗室燈光下，標本看起來有些失調。
An unusually maladjusted figure stood at the center of the design. 設計的中心是一個異常失調的人物。

meaning: 不利於調整
sentences: His maladjustive behavior made it difficult for him to keep a job. 他那難以適應環境的行為讓他很難保住工作。
Avoiding social interaction can be a maladjustive response to stress. 逃避社交互動可能是對壓力的一種適應不良反應。

meaning: 不良、錯誤或不適當的調整。如何用失調造句
sentences: The mechanic fixed the engine maladjustment to stop the car from shaking. 技工修復了引擎調整不當的問題，以防止車輛震動。
Psychological maladjustment can sometimes lead to difficulty in maintaining relationships. 心理上的適應不良有時會導致維繫人際關係的困難。

meaning: 管理不當、不善或低效率。如何用 maladminister造句
sentences: The local board was accused of trying to maladminister the public funds. 地方委員會被指控企圖不當管理公款。
If you maladminister the project's resources, you will run out of money. 如果你錯誤管理專案資源，資金將會耗盡。

meaning: 腐敗或無能的行政管理（如公職）。如何以管理不善造句
sentences: He accepted the maladministration with more caution than pride. 他以謹慎而不是驕傲的態度接受了管理不善。
The old records show how the maladministration shaped local history. 古老的記錄顯示了管理不善如何塑造了當地的歷史。

meaning: 一個罕見的或專門的英語術語，被記錄為管理失當者。
sentences: The company fired the maladministrator who lost all the important files. 公司解雇了那名弄丟所有重要檔案的失職管理者。
A single maladministrator can cause a lot of trouble for the entire team. 一個糟糕的管理者就能給整個團隊帶來很多麻煩。

meaning: 缺乏靈巧：無能。如何在句子中使用 maladroit。 Maladroit 來自古法語和中古法語 Maladroit 的同義詞討論
sentences: The new waiter was quite maladroit and spilled coffee on the customer. 那名新服務生相當笨拙，把咖啡灑在顧客身上了。
His maladroit attempts to fix the sink only made the leak worse. 他笨手笨腳地修理水槽，結果反而讓漏水更嚴重。

meaning: 以一種笨手笨腳的方式。如何使用 maladroitly 造句
sentences: He maladroitly tried to dance, stepping on his partner's toes several times. 他笨拙地試著跳舞，踩到了舞伴的腳趾好幾次。
She handled the heavy boxes maladroitly and almost dropped them. 她搬運重箱子的動作很不靈活，差點把它們掉在地上。

meaning: 笨手笨腳的品質或狀態。如何用 笨拙造句
sentences: The pianist's maladroitness during the recital surprised the audience. 鋼琴家在獨奏會上的笨拙表現讓觀眾感到驚訝。
Her physical maladroitness made her avoid playing most team sports. 她肢體上的不協調讓她避開了大多數的團隊運動。

meaning: 一個罕見的或專門的英語術語，記錄為“maladventure”。
sentences: Our camping trip turned into a maladventure when it started to rain heavily. 當天降大雨時，我們的露營旅行變成了一場不幸的冒險。

sentences: The manager supervised the marshalment of all shipping containers in the yard. 經理在場區監督所有貨櫃的編組工作。
Careful marshalment of the train cars is required before departure. 火車出發前需要仔細進行車廂編組。

meaning: 前英國法院，在王室總管勳爵和騎士元帥面前舉行會議，最初是為了在君主的家僕中主持正義
sentences: The historic Marshalsea court once handled disputes among the royal servants. 歷史悠久的馬歇爾西法庭曾處理皇家僕人之間的糾紛。

meaning: 元帥
sentences: He was promoted to the marshalship after years of dedicated military service. 經過多年全心全意的軍事服務後，他被晉升為元帥之職。

meaning: 歐洲蔓越莓
sentences: We found marshberry growing near the stream bank after the rain. 雨後我們發現溪邊長出了沼澤莓。

meaning: 西塔通加
sentences: The wildlife photographer waited patiently by the water to capture a picture of a marshbuck. 野生動物攝影師在水邊耐心等待，希望能拍到西塔通加羚羊的照片。
We saw a marshbuck hiding among the tall reeds during our safari. 在我們的狩獵之旅中，我們看到一隻西塔通加躲在高高的蘆葦叢裡。

meaning: 火神
sentences: The travelers were frightened by the sudden appearance of marshfire in the dark swamp. 旅行者被黑暗沼澤中突然出現的沼澤火嚇壞了。
Scientists explain that marshfire is just natural gas igniting in the wetlands. 科學家解釋說，沼澤火只是濕地裡的天然氣燃燒。

meaning: 一個罕見的或專門的英語術語，記錄為沼澤花。
sentences: We found marshflower growing near the garden wall after the rain. 雨後我們發現花園圍牆附近長出了沼澤花。
The field guide helped us identify marshflower among the other plants. 現場指南幫助我們在其他植物中識別沼澤花。

meaning: 沼澤的品質或狀態
sentences: The extreme marshiness of the land made it impossible to build a house there. 這片土地極度的沼澤化，根本不可能在那裡建房子。
We had to wear tall rubber boots because of the marshiness of the trail. 由於小徑呈現泥濘狀態，我們必須穿上高筒橡膠靴。

meaning: 一種礦物，是碘化亞銅 CuI，以油棕色等軸晶體形式存在（硬度 2.5，比重 5.6）
sentences: The geologist found a rare sample of marshite during the excavation. 地質學家在挖掘過程中發現了一塊罕見的馬氏石樣本。
Marshite is easily identified in the lab by its oil-brown crystals. 在實驗室中，碘化亞銅礦石很容易透過其油棕色晶體被辨認出來。

meaning: 沼澤地或地區：沼澤。如何用沼澤地造句
sentences: The government plans to protect the local marshland from development. 政府計畫保護當地的沼澤地免受開發。
We saw many rare birds while walking through the marshland. 我們走過沼澤地時，看見了許多珍稀鳥類。

meaning: 一個罕見的或專門的英語術語，記錄為 marshlander。
sentences: As a true marshlander, he knows how to navigate these waterways blindly. 身為真正的沼澤地居民，他閉著眼睛都知道如何在這些水道中航行。
The older marshlanders shared their traditional fishing methods with us. 老一輩的沼澤地居民與我們分享了他們傳統的捕魚方法。

meaning: 類似火神
sentences: From a distance, the shape looked marshlike. 從遠處看，形狀就像沼澤。
The shell had a distinctly marshlike curve. 貝殼有明顯的沼澤狀曲線。

meaning: 沼澤五葉草
sentences: Beautiful purple marshlocks grow along the edges of the quiet pond. 美麗的紫色沼澤五葉草生長在寧靜的池塘邊。
The botanist collected some marshlocks to study their unique leaf structure. 植物學家收集了一些沼澤五葉草，以研究其獨特的葉片結構。

meaning: 住在沼澤地的人；特別是：在廣闊的沼澤地地區生活和謀生的群體成員
sentences: The old marshman knew every hidden waterway in the vast wetlands. 那位老沼澤居民熟悉這片廣大濕地裡每一條隱藏的水道。
As a marshman, he makes his living by fishing and gathering reeds. 身為一個沼澤地居民，他靠捕魚和採集蘆葦維生。

meaning: 傻瓜的豆瓣菜
sentences: The hiker mistakenly picked marshwort instead of the edible plants nearby. 健行者誤採了沼澤草，而不是附近可食用的植物。
Marshwort often grows in shallow streams and can look like true watercress. 沼澤草通常生長在淺溪中，看起來很像真正的豆瓣菜。

meaning: 類似於或構成沼澤。如何用沼澤造句
sentences: Our boots got completely covered in mud after crossing the marshy field. 穿過那片泥濘的田野後，我們的靴子沾滿了泥巴。

meaning: 羅馬以東的古義大利民族
sentences: The Marsi were known as fierce warriors during the ancient Italian conflicts. 在古代義大利的衝突中，馬爾西人以驍勇善戰聞名。
Historians study the Marsi to understand the early cultures east of Rome. 歷史學家研究馬爾西人，以了解羅馬以東的早期文化。

meaning: 義大利馬爾西語的薩貝利亞方言
sentences: The scholar learned Marsian to translate the ancient texts found in the village. 學者學習了馬爾西語，以翻譯在村莊裡發現的古代文本。
The linguist is studying Marsian to understand how local dialects evolved. 語言學家正在研究馬爾西語，以了解當地語言是如何演變的。

meaning: 分佈廣泛的屬（馬西科科的類型），由三葉草蕨組成，有時用作水族箱植物
sentences: We found Marsilea growing near the garden wall after the rain. 雨後我們發現馬西莉亞生長在花園圍牆附近。
The field guide helped us identify Marsilea among the other plants. 現場指南幫助我們在其他植物中識別出馬西利亞。

meaning: 水蕨科的一科，具有異孢子，在同一子實體同時具有小孢子和大孢子
sentences: Plants in the Marsileaceae family often look like four-leaf clovers floating on water. 水蕨科的植物通常看起來像是漂浮在水面上的四葉草。

meaning: 水蕨科的一科，具有異孢子，在同一子實體同時具有小孢子和大孢子
sentences: Botanists describe a specimen as marsileaceous when it is family of water ferns that are heterosporous and have both microspores and megaspores in the same sporocarp. 當一個標本是異孢子並且在同一子實體中同時具有小孢子和大孢子的水蕨科植物時，植物學家將其描述為水蕨科的一科，具有異孢子，在同一子實體同時具有小孢子和大孢子。
Under the lens, the plant looked marsileaceous to the researchers. 在鏡頭下，研究人員認為這種植物看起來像海洋植物。

meaning: marsilea 的分類學同義詞
sentences: The biology students examined the leaves of the Marsilia under the microscope. 生物系學生在顯微鏡下觀察了蘋屬植物的葉子。
We found a patch of Marsilia growing near the edge of the pond. 我們在池塘邊緣發現了一片生長著的蘋屬植物。

meaning: 一個罕見或專門的英語術語，記錄為 Marsiliaceae。
sentences: Ferns belonging to the family Marsiliaceae typically thrive in shallow water. 屬於蘋科的蕨類植物通常在淺水中生長得很好。
The botanical garden has a special section dedicated to Marsiliaceae. 這座植物園有一個專門展示蘋科植物的區域。

meaning: 環口
sentences: A lamprey is a classic example of a marsipobranch found in some rivers. 八目鰻是在某些河流中可以找到的環口綱動物的典型例子。
The marine biologist studied the unique feeding habits of the marsipobranch. 海洋生物學家研究了環口類動物獨特的進食習慣。

meaning: cyclostomi的分類學同義詞；或無頜
sentences: The professor explained how Marsipobranchia differ from modern fish. 教授解釋了圓口綱動物與現代魚類有何不同。
Fossils of Marsipobranchia provide important clues about early vertebrate evolution. 圓口綱動物的化石為早期脊椎動物的演化提供了重要線索。

meaning: cyclostomi的分類學同義詞；或無頜
sentences: Lampreys are a well-known example of the group Marsipobranchiata. 七鰓鰻是圓口綱動物中非常著名的例子。

meaning: cyclostomi的分類學同義詞；或無頜
sentences: The museum features a detailed exhibit on the origins of Marsipobranchii. 博物館展出了一個關於圓口類起源的詳細展覽。

meaning: 罕見或專門的英語術語，記錄為 marsoon。
sentences: Writers use marsoon for rare or specialized English term recorded as marsoon. 作者使用 罕見或專門的英語術語，記錄為 marsoon。 來表示罕見或專門的英語術語，記錄為 罕見或專門的英語術語，記錄為 marsoon。。
The word marsoon still appears in older books and notes. 栗色這個詞仍然出現在較舊的書籍和筆記中。

meaning: 一個罕見或專門的英語術語，記錄為 Marspiter。
sentences: The ancient Romans offered prayers to Marspiter before heading into battle. 古羅馬人在參戰前會向馬斯皮特祈禱。
The inscription on the temple wall was dedicated to Marspiter. 神廟牆上的銘文是獻給馬斯皮特的。

meaning: marssonina 的分類同義詞
sentences: The apple trees in the orchard were infected by a type of Marssonia. 果園裡的蘋果樹感染了一種盤二孢屬真菌。

sentences: The kangaroo is famous for its marsupial pouch used to carry its baby. 袋鼠以用來攜帶幼崽的有袋特徵而聞名。
Researchers are studying the marsupial development of opossums in the wild. 研究人員正在研究野外負鼠的有袋類發育過程。

meaning: 哺乳動物的一個分支，包括袋鼠、袋熊、袋狸、負鼠和相關動物，除了少數例外，它們不發育胎盤，通常在雌性腹部有一個育兒袋，內含乳頭，用於攜帶幼崽
sentences: Researchers observed a Marsupialia near the edge of the field at dawn. 黎明時分，研究人員在田野邊緣附近觀察到了一雙袋動物。

sentences: The surgeon decided that marsupialization was the safest way to treat the large cyst. 外科醫生判定，袋形縫合術是治療這顆大囊腫最安全的方法。

sentences: The doctor had to marsupialize the cyst to allow it to drain properly over time. 醫生必須對囊腫進行有袋化縫合，讓它隨著時間能適當地引流。
If the tumor cannot be completely removed, they might marsupialize the area instead. 如果腫瘤無法完全切除，他們可能會改而在該區域進行有袋化處理。

meaning: 一個罕見的或專門的英語術語，記錄為有袋動物。

meaning: 商店，商店，市場。
sentences: We stopped at the local mart to buy some snacks before the long drive. 在長途開車前，我們在當地的便利商店停下來買了些零食。

meaning: 人們聚集在一起進行買賣：公平。如何用 mart 造句

They are planning to build a new electronics mart near the train station. 他們正計畫在火車站附近建一座新的電子商場。

meaning: 土耳其帽百合

meaning: 錘;特別是：馬特爾-德費爾

meaning: 超然且帶有強烈口音的－用作弓樂器演奏者的指示

meaning: 北半球黃鼠狼科的幾種半樹棲細長肉食性哺乳動物（貂屬）中的一種

meaning: 淬火鋼主要成分的硬質成分

meaning: 淬火鋼主要成分的硬質成分
sentences: The factory produces martensitic stainless steel, which is ideal for making medical instruments. 這家工廠生產馬氏體不鏽鋼，非常適合用來製造醫療器械。

meaning: 一個犯錯的傳教士

meaning: 拉撒路和玛利亚的姐妹，耶稣的朋友

meaning: 一個罕見的或專門的英語術語，記錄為醫學狂。
